introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text: Welcome to Parchís Online. This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is collected, stored and used while using this application. The project has been developed as an academic project at 42 Madrid and is intended for educational purposes.

information.title: 2. Information We Collect
information.text: Depending on how you use the application, the following information may be stored:
items: Messages sent through the lobby chat.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.text: The collected information is only used to provide the services offered by the application, including:

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.text: Reasonable technical measures are implemented to protect user information. Passwords are never stored in plain text and authenticated users can only access resources permitted by the application. HTTPS is used to protect communications between the browser and the server.

sharing.title: 5. Information Sharing
sharing.text: Personal information is never sold or shared with third parties. Other players may only see the information that is necessary for the application to function correctly, such as usernames, avatars, public game statistics and online presence.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.text: The application may use browser storage or authentication tokens to keep users signed in and improve the user experience. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.text: User information remains stored while the account exists and is only retained for the normal operation of the application. Data may be removed if the project database is reset as part of academic development or testing.

changes.title: 9. Changes to this Policy
changes.text: This Privacy Policy may be updated whenever the project evolves or new features are implemented. Users are encouraged to review this page periodically.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.text: Questions regarding this Privacy Policy may be directed to the development team responsible for this academic project at 42 Madrid.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By creating an account or using Parchís Online, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, you should stop using the application.

project.title: 2. About the Project
project.text: Parchís Online is a multiplayer web application developed as an academic project at 42 Madrid. The application is intended for educational purposes and may change, temporarily become unavailable or be reset during development.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.intro: Users are responsible for the information associated with their accounts. Each user agrees to:
items: Be responsible for all activity performed using their account.
Respect other users while using the platform.

fairPlay.title: 4. Fair Play
fairPlay.intro: Players are expected to participate fairly in every match. The following behaviour is prohibited:
items: Modifying the client to gain an unfair advantage.

community.title: 5. Community Rules
community.intro: Users must behave respectfully while interacting with others through the application.

property.title: 6. Intellectual Property
property.text: The source code, interface design and original assets of this project are the work of its development team. Any third-party libraries, icons or resources remain the property of their respective owners.

availability.title: 7. Availability
availability.text: Since this application is an academic project, continuous availability is not guaranteed. Maintenance, updates or database resets may occur without prior notice.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
liability.text: The application is provided for educational purposes. Although reasonable efforts are made to ensure stability and security, the development team cannot guarantee that the service will always operate without interruptions or errors.

termination.title: 9. Termination
termination.text: Access to the application may be restricted or suspended if a user violates these Terms of Service or intentionally disrupts the normal operation of the platform.

changes.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
changes.text: These Terms of Service may be updated whenever new functionality is added or project requirements change. Continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of the latest version.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.text: Questions regarding these Terms of Service may be directed to the development team responsible for this academic project at 42 Madrid.
